items.en: Iranian Military Leader Vows Tehran 'Will Not Submit' as US Prepares Further Economic Squeeze
items.zh: 伊朗軍方強硬回應：德黑蘭「不會屈服」，美方週一公布加碼制裁
items.summary: A close ally of Iran's supreme leader dismissed President Trump's war rhetoric as a sign of desperation and vowed that Tehran "will not submit" to American pressure. The statement came as Washington prepared to sharply escalate economic sanctions on Iran, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent due to detail the package at a Monday press conference. Iranian officials warned that anyone who orders or implements the new levies would be "liable to prosecution and punishment." The exchange caps a week in which oil, gold and defensive assets all pushed higher while equity investors stayed cautious ahead of Monday's announcement.

items.en: China Pushes Back on Trump's 'Economic D-Day' Threat Over Iran Trade
items.zh: 中國反擊川普「經濟諾曼第登陸」威脅：制裁不符合任何一方利益
items.summary: Beijing responded to President Trump's threat of an "economic D-Day" against Iran by arguing that sanctions do not "fit the interest of any party." China is by far Iran's largest trading partner, absorbing the bulk of Iranian oil and non-oil exports, which makes it the implicit target of Washington's warning that third countries doing business with Tehran will face consequences. The dispute turns a regional military conflict into a direct test of US-China economic relations, and analysts expect any secondary-sanctions mechanism to be the single most market-sensitive detail in Monday's rollout.

items.en: Iran to Let Iraqi Oil Tankers Transit the Strait of Hormuz
items.zh: 伊朗鬆口：允許伊拉克油輪通行荷莫茲海峽
items.summary: Iranian state media said Tehran will allow Iraqi oil tankers to move through the Strait of Hormuz, a narrow but meaningful easing of the chokepoint that has driven this year's energy crisis. Iran and Oman also held talks on the strait's status. The concession is limited: Iranian crude loadings themselves have collapsed to roughly one-seventh of pre-war levels, averaging about 287,000 barrels per day this month against roughly 2 million before the conflict. Traders read the move as Tehran trying to keep regional partners onside rather than a genuine reopening of the waterway.

items.en: US Gasoline Prices Up Nearly a Dollar Year on Year as Hormuz Traffic Stays Depressed
items.zh: 荷莫茲運量持續低迷，美國油價年增近 1 美元
items.summary: What started as a crude supply shock from the Strait of Hormuz blockage is turning into a refined-fuel crisis. American pump prices are now close to a dollar per gallon higher than a year ago, as refineries face the combined pressure of wartime disruption and export restrictions that limit how much crude they can convert into gasoline, jet fuel and diesel. The squeeze is now a consumer-inflation story rather than purely an energy one, and it complicates the Federal Reserve's path just as bond markets have already been unusually volatile.

items.en: Trump Posts Map Labelling the Strait of Hormuz 'New US Territory'
items.zh: 川普貼出將荷莫茲海峽標為「美國新領土」的地圖，伊朗外交部強烈譴責
items.summary: President Trump posted an image on social media showing the Strait of Hormuz labelled as "New US Territory" alongside a threat of "crushing economic warfare" against Iran. Iran's foreign ministry condemned the post and repeated its warning of prosecution for those implementing new sanctions. Washington separately imposed fresh sanctions on Hezbollah and formally designated the Lebanese group an Iranian proxy. The rhetorical escalation matters because a June memorandum of understanding intended to end the conflict within 60 days collapsed in July after Iran struck three commercial vessels.

items.en: Nvidia Strikes Unusual $6 Billion AI Licensing Deal With Coding Startup Poolside
items.zh: 輝達用 60 億美元「授權＋投資＋挖人」拿下 AI 編程新創 Poolside，不做併購
items.summary: Nvidia agreed to pay $6 billion under a non-exclusive licensing agreement with AI coding startup Poolside and to invest a further $1 billion at a $12 billion pre-money valuation, while extending job offers to about 109 Poolside employees. Crucially, Nvidia is not buying the company. The structure lets a cash-rich acquirer secure scarce models and engineers while leaving the original corporate entity operating independently, sidestepping some antitrust and integration friction. For Nvidia it is a push beyond chips into the software and model layer, and it may become a template for how Big Tech absorbs AI talent.

items.en: Apple Music Will Visibly Label Songs 'Materially Generated Using AI'
items.zh: Apple Music 將標示「主要由 AI 生成」的歌曲，AI 透明標籤擴大適用
items.summary: Apple told music-industry partners it will display visible labels on tracks that content providers identify as materially generated using AI, extending its broader AI Transparency Tags programme. Streaming services are already grappling with synthetic performers, voice cloning, fraudulent uploads and huge volumes of cheaply generated music that listeners cannot easily distinguish from human recordings. Rather than banning AI music outright, Apple shifts the burden onto distributors and rights holders to classify recordings honestly. The approach is likely to pressure Spotify and others toward a common labelling standard.

items.en: OpenAI Brings ChatGPT Into Apple Messages on macOS
items.zh: ChatGPT 進駐 Mac 版 iMessage：可讀取、搜尋、摘要與代寫訊息
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out a Messages integration for ChatGPT on macOS that lets the assistant read, search, summarise, draft and send messages once users grant permission. It is another step toward assistants acting as an operating layer across email, calendars, documents and browsers rather than sitting in a separate chat window. The convenience carries real risk: a malicious instruction embedded inside an incoming message could become a prompt-injection vector if permissions are broad. OpenAI says Messages data is processed locally and that it does not build a separate index of user conversations.

items.en: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner Withdraws From the US Open With a Knee Injury
items.zh: 世界第一辛納因右膝傷勢退出美網，男單賽局全面洗牌
items.summary: Jannik Sinner confirmed he will not play the US Open because of a right knee injury, removing the world number one from the season's final Grand Slam. The withdrawal blows the men's draw wide open and hands a significant ranking-points opportunity to his closest rivals. Sinner did not give a firm timetable for return. Knee problems are particularly awkward for a player whose game depends on absorbing pace from the baseline and changing direction late, so the bigger question is whether this is a short lay-off or the start of a managed workload for the rest of the year.

items.en: Everton Beat Crystal Palace 2-0 as the Premier League Season Opens
items.zh: 英超開幕週：埃弗頓 2-0 擊敗水晶宮，伊普斯威奇與桑德蘭 1-1 平手
items.summary: Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall opened the scoring with a fine strike before half-time and Thierno Barry headed in Iliman Ndiaye's cross to seal a 2-0 Everton win over Crystal Palace in Matchweek 1. Elsewhere Ipswich and Sunderland drew 1-1, with Nilson Angulo scoring from a free kick for Sunderland. Opening-weekend results carry limited predictive weight, but Everton's clean sheet and the fluency of the Ndiaye-Barry connection are early evidence that their summer recruitment addressed the chance-creation problem that defined last season.

items.en: Toronto Tempo Snap a 12-Game Losing Streak; Diamondbacks Blank the Reds 9-0
items.zh: WNBA 多倫多 Tempo 終結 12 連敗；MLB 響尾蛇 9-0 完封紅人
items.summary: Isabelle Harrison posted 25 points and 10 rebounds as the expansion Toronto Tempo beat the Portland Fire 82-79 to end a 12-game losing streak, a milestone night for the WNBA's newest franchise. In baseball, Jordan Lawlar hit a two-run homer and drove in three as the Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Cincinnati Reds 9-0, while the Seattle Mariners edged the Chicago Cubs 6-5 in ten innings on a Leo Rivas walk-off single. All three results land in the closing stretch of their respective regular seasons.

items.en: Johns Hopkins Study of 560,000 Students Finds 15 Years of Rising Depression Symptoms
items.zh: 約翰霍普金斯研究：56 萬名大學生、15 年間憂鬱症狀持續上升（若這些數字讓你想到自己的狀況，成大健康與諮商輔導組隨時可以聊聊，1925 安心專線 24 小時都在）
items.summary: A 2026 Johns Hopkins Medicine analysis of health survey data from more than 560,000 US college students between 2007 and 2022 found that depression symptoms rose steadily across the entire 15-year window, with reported suicidal ideation increasing by close to 154%. The scale of the dataset is what makes it notable: it covers a period spanning the rise of smartphones, the pandemic and the post-pandemic return to campus, and the upward trend is consistent rather than driven by any single shock. Researchers stress that increased willingness to report symptoms explains only part of the rise.

items.en: YouGov Survey: Nearly 70% of College Students Reported a Mental Health Concern in the Past Year
items.zh: YouGov 全美調查：近 7 成大學生過去一年出現心理健康困擾，焦慮與壓力居首
items.summary: A 2026 national survey conducted by YouGov for UnitedHealthcare found that close to 70% of college students reported experiencing a mental health concern within the previous twelve months, with anxiety, stress, depression and ADD/ADHD the most frequently cited. The figure is high enough that it reframes campus mental health as a majority experience rather than a minority one. That distinction matters for policy: services designed as specialist referral pathways for a small group behave very differently from services expected to absorb most of the student body.

items.en: First-Generation Students Get Therapy at Markedly Lower Rates Than Their Peers
items.zh: 第一代大學生就醫率明顯偏低：有症狀者僅 32.8% 接受治療，對照組為 42.8%
items.summary: Findings from the national Healthy Minds Study show that among students with mental health symptoms, only 32.8% of first-generation college students had received therapy in the past year, compared with 42.8% of continuing-generation students. Related research found that experiences of discrimination predicted higher levels of imposterism, which in turn predicted poorer mental health outcomes for African American, Latino and Asian American students. The pattern points to an access-and-belonging problem rather than a difference in underlying need, which implies outreach design matters as much as service capacity.

items.en: Anthropic Prepares an IPO That Could Rival SpaceX's Record-Breaking Debut
items.zh: Anthropic 準備 IPO，規模可能挑戰 SpaceX 史上最大紀錄，最快 8 月底遞件
items.summary: Anthropic is preparing what could become one of the largest initial public offerings ever, with people familiar with the process saying the Claude maker expects to match or exceed the size of SpaceX's record debut and could file registration documents as soon as the end of August. Annualised revenue reportedly reached roughly $65 billion by the end of July, driven by enterprise spending on Claude and AI agents. A listing would fund compute, data centres and chips, but would also expose Anthropic's margins, governance and capital intensity to public-market scrutiny for the first time.

items.en: Broadcom Seeks More Than $60 Billion in Debt for an AI Chip Financing Package
items.zh: 博通洽談逾 600 億美元債務融資，AI 基建正式變成一種資產類別
items.summary: Broadcom is in talks with lenders over more than $60 billion of debt for an AI chip financing structure that could reach roughly $100 billion including junior tranches. The money would support AI infrastructure involving Anthropic and potentially other frontier labs. The mechanism is as significant as the number: instead of loading enormous capital expenditure onto corporate balance sheets, chipmakers, private credit firms and banks are building special-purpose vehicles around expected future compute demand. Broadcom previously worked with Blackstone and Apollo on similar Anthropic-linked financing.

items.en: Google's Open Gemma Models Pass One Billion Downloads
items.zh: Google 開源模型 Gemma 突破 10 億次下載，社群衍生版本超過 10 萬個
items.summary: Google DeepMind says its openly available Gemma model family has passed one billion downloads, with developers publishing more than 100,000 fine-tuned variants since launch roughly two years ago. Google is also opening an "Awesome Gemma" GitHub repository to catalogue notable tools and community projects. The milestone underlines that small open models running on laptops, edge devices and private servers are a genuine strategic front alongside frontier systems like Gemini, Claude and GPT, and that developer-ecosystem adoption has become a competitive battleground in its own right.

items.en: back number 'Grateful Yesterdays Tour 2026' — FINAL Taipei Night, TONIGHT at Taipei Arena
items.zh: 🔥 今晚就是最終場：back number 台北小巨蛋 8/23（日）18:00，門票 SOLD OUT
items.summary: back number's first-ever Asian tour closes its Taiwan run tonight, Sunday 23 August 2026, at Taipei Arena — the second of two nights after Saturday's opener. Doors open 16:30 and the show starts 18:00. Tonight's performance is sold out. Tickets were distributed by real-name lottery in April with a final general sale on 7 May, priced from NT$800 to NT$5,280, with NT$400 accessible seating. Taipei was chosen as the opening stop of the entire tour. Note the age rules: under-7s are not admitted and under-110cm is barred from third-floor seating.

items.en: Official HIGE DANdism Asia Tour 2026 Hits Taipei Arena on 29-30 August — Next Weekend
items.zh: 髭男 Official髭男dism 亞洲巡演 8/29–30 台北小巨蛋兩場，就在下週末
items.summary: Official HIGE DANdism confirmed their Asia Tour 2026 routing on the band's official account: Seoul KSPO Dome on 8-9 August, Singapore's The Star Theatre on 21 August, and Taipei Arena on 29-30 August 2026. That puts two Taipei nights exactly one week after back number leaves the same venue, an unusually dense stretch of major J-POP dates in Taiwan. If you have not secured tickets yet, resale and any released restricted-view seats typically surface in the final week before the show, so this is the window to watch.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Sixth Album Lands 30 September Alongside the 'SHADOWS' Arena Tour
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張原創專輯 9/30 發行，同日開跑三年來首次巡迴「SHADOWS」
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on 30 September 2026, their first release of "Phase 3," with confirmed tracks including "Carrying Happiness," "Natsu no Kage," "GOOD DAY," "lulu.," "Kaze to Machi" and "Variety." The Ringo Jam Tour "SHADOWS" launches the same day and runs through December across arenas in Kagawa, Hiroshima, Chiba, Hokkaido, Tokyo, Saga, Fukui, Nagano and Kobe — 28 performances at 13 venues, their first arena tour in roughly three years. No overseas dates have been announced so far.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce a 10-City Asian Dome and Stadium Tour for 2026-2027
items.zh: YOASOBI「超惑星」亞洲 10 城巨蛋巡演：日本 5 場已定，亞洲 5 城待公布（台北有機會）
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced the ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027 "Chowakusei," billed as the first Asian dome-and-stadium run of this scale by a Japanese act. Five Japanese dates are confirmed: Kyocera Dome Osaka 24-25 October, Vantelin Dome Nagoya 7-8 November, Daiwa House Premist Dome Sapporo 14-15 November, Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka 28-29 November and Tokyo Dome 5-6 December 2026. Reserved seats are priced at JPY 14,000. The remaining five Asian cities have not been named yet — worth watching if you want Taipei or Hong Kong.

items.en: Vaundy Takes the Koshien Theme Song and Lines Up a 2026 Dome Show
items.zh: Vaundy 唱下第 108 回夏季甲子園主題曲，2026 巨蛋公演也在規劃中
items.summary: Vaundy wrote and performed the opening theme for the 108th National High School Baseball Championship and the accompanying "Nettou Koshien" broadcast, one of the most widely heard music slots in Japan each August. He is also making a five-week consecutive run of appearances on TBS's "CDTV Live! Live!" and has a dome concert in the pipeline for 2026. For anyone tracking the current J-POP top tier, the July weekly charts placed Mrs. GREEN APPLE at number one, back number second and Kenshi Yonezu third, with Fujii Kaze also inside the top ten.

market.note: ★ 提醒：今天是週日，8/22 週六與今天都沒有開盤，所以下面的數字**和昨天那份晨報完全一樣**，都是 8/21（五）的收盤。這不是資料沒更新，是市場真的沒動。　【台股 8/21】加權指數開低走高，開盤 44,923.34、終場收 45,224.29 點、上漲 290.55 點（+0.65%），重新站回 45K，成交金額約 7,192–7,207 億元（不同來源略有出入）。台積電收 2,410 元、漲 35 元（+1.47%），單一檔就撐住大半指數。真正的主角是航運：萬海亮燈漲停、陽明爆量 19.7 萬張大漲 6.14%、長榮也漲 2.24%。記憶體族群換了領頭羊——南亞科、華邦電只是力守紅盤，衝最前面的是模組廠創見（2451），盤中觸及漲停 312.5 元（+9.84%）。三大法人合計買超約 320–331 億元。　【美股 8/21】道瓊收 53,276.81 點、大漲 517.60 點（+0.98%），S&P 500 收 7,674.31（+0.43%），那斯達克收 26,180.46（+0.43%），羅素 2000 漲 0.88%。四個數字的排序本身就是訊息：道瓊與小型股 > 科技股，代表資金正從 AI 大型股往外擴散。Dow 成分股漲最多的是高盛（+1.69%）、聯合健康（+1.48%）、美國運通（+1.46%）；跌最多的是亞馬遜（-1.01%）、蘋果（-0.90%）、波音（-0.53%）。　【但三大指數整週仍收黑】本週前半段公債殺盤把風險資產壓得很慘，週四道瓊一度重挫 703.84 點。財長貝森特週四宣布擴大公債買回、單筆規模拉高到 40 億美元以上，殖利率只短暫回落就彈回原位，市場顯然把這當止痛藥而非解方。　【下週看什麼】週一貝森特的伊朗制裁記者會是本週最大變數，尤其是「次級制裁」條款會不會直接掃到中國。制裁若比預期強，油、金再漲、科技股再被壓；若只是喊話，這週五的反彈才有延續性。
market.highlight: 🆕 清單外四檔值得認識（沿用 8/21 收盤，週末未變動）：　① 創見（2451）記憶體模組，8/21 亮燈漲停 +9.84%、收 312.5 元，接棒南亞科成為記憶體新領頭羊——追記憶體循環的話，「領頭羊換人」是很重要的訊號。　② 萬海（2615）貨櫃航運，Q2 獲利年增近 10 倍，8/21 收漲停 +9.69%。　③ 陽明（2609）+6.14% 收 64 元、成交爆到 197,074 張、連 6 根紅 K。航運這波是「財報實績＋資金輪動」雙引擎，不是純題材股；但法人已經在提隱憂：運價高點能撐多久沒人知道。　④ BitMine Immersion（BMNR），美股加密礦業／以太坊庫存策略股，隨比特幣衝上 7.7 萬美元大漲約 5%，是清單外最猛的加密代理股。　🪙 加密貨幣週末仍在交易：比特幣 8/21 收 76,943.90 美元（單日 +6%），整週大漲約 22%（週初約 62,800 美元起算），是兩年來最強單週。推手是財政部擴大公債買回釋放流動性，加上川普喊話要通過加密法案。但要有心理準備：BTC 仍遠低於 2026 年 1 月高點 94,820 美元，更別說 2025 年 10 月的歷史高點 126,198 美元。以太坊 8/21 約 2,402 美元（+5.1%）。週末盤薄，別把週末的價格波動當成方向確認。
